card.name: Time word after last, next, this
card.fires_on: A time noun such as June, week, month, Friday or time right after "last", "next" or "this". Also "step" after "next".

modes.label: Last/next + calendar word
modes.description: A month, weekday or period word right after "last" or "next" in news or general text.
modes.example: There will be an unexpected sight high in the skies over the British county of Norfolk next<< month>>: a huge balloon attached to the ground

modes.label: This + time
modes.description: The word "time" after "this" referring to a period just described, as in label instructions.
modes.example: Clear liquids may be consumed during this<< time>> (e.g., water, apple juice

modes.label: Next step
modes.description: The word "step" after "next" in a process.
modes.example: The next<< step>> was to convert

card.plain: It fires on the noun that follows "last", "next" or "this" when pointing to a time or stage.
